name: Commission for the Arts Regular Meeting
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Commission for the Arts Regular Meeting
AGENDA
DECEMBER 1, 2025 -
05:00 PM
City of Encinitas - Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Ave
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS None.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF Each speaker has three (3) minutes to address the Commission for the Arts. There are no time donations during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the Clerk. Direction to staff to bring back a future agenda item or provide additional information to answer a question requires consent of at least two Commission Members.
6.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announce administrative changes to the agenda in compliance with the Brown Act.
7.
APPROVAL OF THE MINUTES Approve the November 3, 2025, Regular Meeting Minutes.
7. November 3, 2025 Regular Meeting Minutes
8.
ACTION ITEMS
8A.
Encinitas Holiday Parade Participation.
1.
Discuss and determine the Commission’s participation in the annual Holiday Parade.
8A. Encinitas Holiday Parade Participation
8B.
Commission for the Arts Annual Work Plan.
2.
Discuss the 2025-26 Work Plan and provide updates.
1.
Discuss City Council-directed items
a.
Joint Meeting Review
b.
Generate ideas that could help generate revenue funding to contribute to the Pacific View Arts Center with a goal for this work plan year to be a list of ideas generated. If it can be taken all the way to a program, that would be a stretch goal. Review class cancellations.
c.
Recommend goals and policies for the Arts that are consistent with all the other General Plan elements. Add something called out in the Recreation element that talks about arts.
2.
Review the updated Sculpture Loan Program details and timeline.
3.
Discuss the commission’s recommendation on the donation of public art sculpture from Encinitas Friends of the Arts by artist Deanne Sabeck. Discuss locations and collect public input.
4.
Form ad hoc committees as needed to complete work plan goals.
8B. Commission for the Arts Annual Work Plan
9.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
9A.
Cultural Arts Division Report
1.
Pacific View Arts Center – Assistant Center Manager Nemerow
2.
City-run programs – Supervisor Roberts
9B.
Commission Calendar -- Arts Division Supervisor Roberts
1.
Winter Registration Opens: December 1, 2025, 8:00am
2.
Encinitas Holiday Parade: December 6, 2025, 5:30pm, Coast Hwy 101
3.
Wednesdays@Noon: December 3, 10, and 17, 2025, Encinitas Library
No concerts on December 24 and 31, 2025
4.
Nutcracker: December 13, 2025, 2pm and 6pm, both sold out
5.
Pacific View Arts Center Open House: December 18. 2025, 5-7:00pm
6.
Regular Commission Meeting: January 5, 2026, 5:00pm, Council Chambers
7.
Music by the Sea Concert 1: January 23, 2026, 7:00pm, Encinitas Library
9C.
Department Updates – Recreation Services Manager Hamer
10.
COMMISSION MEMBER-INITIATED AGENDA ITEM. Commissioner prepared and presented agenda items.
11.
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS ADDED BY COMMISSION MEMBERS Future agenda items may be requested with consensus of two or more Commissioners.
12.
COMMISSIONERS’ REPORTS
ADJOURNMENT
